problem: The file is opened in write mode, which truncates it and makes json.load fail, instead of opening it for reading.
The loop stops at len(items) - 1, so the last item is left out of the total.
The mutable default argument tags=[] is shared across calls, so tags accumulate instead of starting from an empty list each time.
The comparison uses > instead of >=, so an item with exactly qty in stock is wrongly reported as unable to fulfil.
The percent is divided by 10 instead of 100, so the discount is ten times too large.
The comparison is inverted (> instead of <), returning items with stock above the reorder level rather than below it.
Using 'or 1' turns a quantity of 0 into 1, so a cancelled order does not stay 0.
